name: T055 (v0.7 part 2): FR-012 gives a `directives.<name>` entry the same closed per-key vocabulary a top-level `keys.<name>` entry has, and it is enforced the same way — a stray `seal:` (the pre-v0.7 per-key spelling) is refused as unknown-key-vocabulary-keyword here exactly as it is at a `keys.<name>` entry (T053).
